desc: baseline: unmodified tree, oltp PROFILE=1 MYSQL=1

asi.gap: vitess at 10.6% of mysql qps; single-threaded so latency-bound: ~4.3ms overhead per 20-query transaction

desc: parallel multi-shard commit in TxConn.commitNormal (was serial per shard)

asi.conclusion: no gain vs baseline mean ~5094; expected +5% from removing 1 serial commit RTT but goroutine spawn+handoff on GOMAXPROCS=2 likely eats the savings. Commit RPCs also not counted in VttabletCall histogram so commit cost per txn may be smaller than assumed.
asi.theory_formed: systemic tax is Go netpoll/scheduler wakeup latency (~10-20us) occurring ~6x per query across vtgate+tablet; explains tablet mysql layer 64us vs 24us raw, and grpc hop 95us vs 40us net floor
asi.next: test wakeup-latency theory with env-gated scheduler spinner goroutine

desc: scheduler spinner goroutine (for{Gosched()}) in servenv, env-gated VT_SCHED_SPIN, enabled on vtgate+tablets

asi.conclusion: 8x WORSE. Busy-spin exhausts docker CFS quota (cpu.max 200000/100000) -> multi-ms throttle pauses (p95 42ms). NEVER busy-spin under cgroup cpu limits.
asi.still_open: wakeup-latency theory unconfirmed (test confounded by throttling)
asi.next: isolate go/mysql client overhead vs raw C client with a minimal Go binary inside the container

desc: diagnostic: go/mysql client tight-loop in idle process inside mysql-1001 container

asi.conclusion: go/mysql client is fast (12.6us vs C client 10.3us). The 64us seen in busy vttablet = ~50us scheduler/wakeup tax. No CFS throttling under normal load. Attack handoffs/wakeups, not client code.
asi.tool: .auto/diag_mysqlbench/main.go, cross-compile GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0, docker cp into mysql container

desc: grpc.NumStreamWorkers(GOMAXPROCS) on servenv grpc server (vtgate+vttablet) - reuse stream worker goroutines instead of per-RPC spawn

asi.protocol_change: measure.sh now BENCH_REPEAT=3 within one cluster + median; within-cluster spread ~1%, cluster-to-cluster ±4-5%

desc: GOGC=200 + drop GOMEMLIMIT=1GiB (was GOGC=off) on vtgate+tablets

asi.ab: two independent clusters: 5417 (5279-5445) and 5424 (5398-5424) vs exp5 5288. +2.5%
asi.why: GOGC=off+memlimit causes rare full-1GiB GC cycles with assist storms (10-50ms histogram outliers); GOGC=200 does small frequent cycles
asi.note: env-only change in benchmarks compose files

desc: bidi-stream Execute pipe: queryservice.QueryPipe/ExecutePipe grpc service + client pipe pool in grpctabletconn, replaces per-query unary Execute

asi.design: one in-flight request per pipe, pool for concurrency, error terminates pipe w/ full grpc status, Unimplemented->permanent unary fallback, ctx enforced via context.AfterFunc cancel
asi.caveat: per-call grpc-timeout no longer propagated to tablet (tablet's own query timeout still applies); errors cost a stream re-setup
asi.validation: tabletconntest conformance suite passes through pipe path; 0 sysbench errors
asi.next: extend pipe to BeginExecute/Commit (4 of ~22 calls/txn)
